description: Checks whether an employer must offer occupational integration management under German law (betriebliches Eingliederungsmanagement, BEM, § 167 Abs. 2 SGB IX): more than 6 weeks of incapacity to work within the last 12 months, counted in calendar days and in working days, whatever the cause. Returns the counts, the day the limit was crossed and the next steps. Applies from the first employee. Germany only.

arbeitstage.description: Working days of the person, default Mo to Fr

stichtag.description: Reference date, the 12 months before it are counted; default today (YYYY-MM-DD)

zeitraeume.description: Periods of incapacity to work (Arbeitsunfähigkeit) of any cause, incl. partial incapacity. Follow-up notes as one period.

bis.description: Last day; leave out if still ongoing (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: bem_pflicht

ergebnis.description: Result of the tool; its fields differ per tool

title: BEM-Pflicht prüfen
